name: Omni-MATH
description: An Olympiad-level mathematical benchmark with multilingual and multimodal support, drawing problems from AMC, AIME, and international mathematical olympiad competitions. Requires multi-step symbolic reasoning, application of advanced mathematical theorems, and creative problem-solving strategies. Designed as a contamination-resistant successor to MATH-500 for evaluating elite mathematical reasoning in frontier models.
typical_sota_score: ~30–50% (frontier reasoning models; below human olympiad competitor performance)
reputation: Featured across 2024–2025 conference proceedings; targets competition math beyond GSM8K and MATH-500; incorporates recent competition problems for contamination resistance; bilingual and multimodal coverage
notes: Features competition problems from AMC 8/10/12, AIME, MATHCOUNTS, and international olympiads across multiple years. Multilingual coverage includes English, Chinese, and French. Multimodal variants include geometry figures and diagrams. Incorporates recent (post-2023) competition problems to minimize contamination. Expert-verified solutions and step-by-step annotations available.
